description: Set the cell space remapping interval. If i is greater than 0 (defaults to 0), clumps are checked for remapping in the cell space every i cycles. As cell space remapping triggers checks for creation/deletion of contacts, changing this setting impacts the number of contacts in the system and rate at which they are created and/or deleted.

examples.description: Check clumps for cell-space remapping every 10 cycles

verification: Live-verified 2026-11-10 on the PFC2D/PFC3D 9.8 consoles (syntax grade): 'clump remap-interval 10' accepted on both; a non-integer argument rejected with the engine's integer expectation; the keyword is absent from the 6.00 and 7.00 clump enumerations.
